frequency_reference.caveat: Equal declared references do not measure temporal B0 drift or prove identical shim fields.

navigators.bound_interpretation: Conservative candidate bound for an additional shared residual phase, not a confidence interval or a measured correction.
navigators.caveat: Navigator fits precede imaging; small navigator residuals do not prove absence of later gradient or phase drift.

phase_encoding_degeneracy.identifiability_policy: Do not jointly fit global frequency offset and PE translation from one magnitude EPI; keep PE translation fixed or constrain it independently.
phase_encoding_degeneracy.global_phase_policy: A common complex phase does not change magnitude and is not a magnitude-calibration parameter.
phase_encoding_degeneracy.frame_policy: A joint transform of spins, k and reconstruction cannot identify physical coil registration at zero current.

validation_policy: Keep bounds, B0 weighting and masks fixed before calibration; never fit a free field or deformation.
With one scan, hold out spatial blocks or adjacent odd/even line pairs; holding out one parity alone cannot validate odd/even phase.
Fit gains on training data and freeze them for validation; reject bounds-saturating or unstable parameter estimates.
Internal held-out checks do not replace a second acquisition; freeze calibration before optimizing shim currents.
